name: Neglect
overview: Scripture warns against neglecting the needs of the poor and just, highlighting how turning them away from their rights is a grievous sin (Amos 5:12). True service to God requires wholehearted devotion, as divided loyalty leads to despising what God values (Matthew 6:24; Luke 16:15). The example of the rich man who lived in luxury without regard for others (Luke 16:19) illustrates the danger of neglecting compassion and righteousness. Believers are called to support one another in faith and avoid judgment over doubts, fostering a community that honors God’s standards (Romans 14:1).
